advisories.title: nanoid: non-secure generators can loop indefinitely with negative size
advisories.reachability: Build API present through PostCSS, but its Nano ID call uses a fixed positive size of 6, not an attacker-controlled negative size. No current trigger found.

advisories.title: undici vulnerable to TLS certificate validation bypass via dropped tls options in Agent
advisories.reachability: Requires function-valued TLS options passed through Agent tls rather than connect. The project configures no custom TLS verification callback. Vendor-internal optional TLS paths are patched through Undici.

advisories.title: nanoid: custom generators can loop indefinitely when size is zero
advisories.reachability: Requires a custom generator configured with size zero. No such call in website/build code; PostCSS uses a fixed positive size. No current trigger found.

advisories.title: undici vulnerable to Denial of Service via unbounded memory in the EventSource parser
advisories.reachability: Requires an EventSource connection to a hostile SSE peer. No website or test EventSource client exists. Vendor-internal tooling paths were not proven absent; dependency patched rather than excepted.

advisories.title: undici vulnerable to cache poisoning and cross-user disclosure via cross-origin redirects
advisories.reachability: Requires an originless Agent, shared cache, and redirect-before-cache interceptor composition. The project configures none of these. Vendor internals are not blanket-exempted; patched transitively.

advisories.title: undici vulnerable to Denial of Service via unhandled exception in the decompress interceptor
advisories.reachability: Requires the decompress interceptor composed with a downstream throwing handler such as dump. No such composition in project code. Tooling dependency patched, without assuming vendor APIs cannot be reached.

advisories.title: launch-editor: `fs.existsSync()` existence check can be bypassed on Windows
advisories.reachability: Windows editor path check bypass can compose with command escaping bugs. Relevant to a running development server/editor middleware; not a public static-asset execution path.

advisories.title: source-map-js allows event-loop denial of service through indexed source-map section offsets
advisories.reachability: Requires a hostile indexed source map with huge section offsets. No input map upload endpoint or authored external map annotation exists; conditional build-time denial of service if hostile map input is introduced.

advisories.title: launch-editor: escapeCmdArgs() omits % escaping on Windows
advisories.reachability: Windows editor command escaping, malicious filename/environment or alternate data stream. Relevant to development editor actions; no editor invocation in CI or static assets hosting.

advisories.title: undici WebSocket client vulnerable to Denial of Service via unbounded automatic PONG buffering
advisories.reachability: Requires a WebSocket client connected to a hostile peer that sends PING frames without reading PONGs. No website WebSocket client exists. Local tooling/inspector paths remain a conditional tool risk and are patched.

advisories.title: Vite: Cross origin script execution through Vite custom middleware
advisories.reachability: Requires custom/middleware-mode transformIndexHtml using the unchanged request URL and an inline module. This site uses appType mpa, no custom request transform, and build-time rendering, so those preconditions are absent.

advisories.title: undici vulnerable to Subresource Integrity bypass via non-lowercase algorithm tokens
advisories.reachability: Requires fetch with a Subresource Integrity value using a non-lowercase algorithm token. No project server-side fetch integrity option exists. Tooling dependency patched; browser-native fetch is a separate implementation.

advisories.title: vite: `server.fs.deny` bypass on Windows alternate paths
advisories.reachability: Windows development fs.deny bypass through alternate paths. The public site serves only generated files, not the Vite development filesystem. Patch protects developer tooling.

advisories.title: PostCSS: incomplete fix of GHSA-6g55-p6wh-862q — attacker-controlled sourceMappingURL reads arbitrary .map files when `from` is unset
advisories.reachability: Requires processing hostile CSS with a previous-map annotation while from is unset. Vite sets from to the source path; no CSS upload/parser service or authored map annotation exists. Conditional build risk, no current trigger found.

advisories.title: undici vulnerable to Denial of Service via TLS 1.2 certificate-changing renegotiation
advisories.reachability: A malicious HTTPS peer renegotiating TLS 1.2 can crash a client. Conditional risk for outbound tooling requests; not a visitor-triggered API in this static architecture.

advisories.title: PostCSS: Path Traversal in Previous Source Map Auto-Loading (sourceMappingURL) leads to Arbitrary .map File Disclosure
advisories.reachability: Earlier traversal variant can process a hostile CSS map even with from set. Trusted repository CSS has no previous-map annotation. A malicious source/dependency change could affect a build; no visitor-facing CSS transformation service exists.

advisories.title: launch-editor: Editor CLI flag misinterpretation causing arbitrary command execution for some editors
advisories.reachability: Editor CLI flag interpretation requires malicious filesystem names and affected editor/WSL conditions. No editor is invoked by the build, tests, or production static hosting.

advisories.title: Vite: Files outside `server.fs.allow` could be served when project paths match system paths on non-Windows machine
advisories.reachability: Development file exposure requires matching root-relative imports and host filesystem paths on non-Windows. Current imports do not match this pattern. Build and static preview do not expose the Vite development filesystem middleware.

advisories.title: launch-editor: NTLMv2 hash disclosure via UNC path handling on Windows
advisories.reachability: Windows development open-in-editor middleware can cause outbound SMB/NTLM authentication. A malicious browser page may reach loopback; loopback binding alone is not a complete mitigation. No editor middleware runs in static hosting or normal CI builds.

advisories.title: undici vulnerable to Denial of Service via unhandled error on excessive content-encodings
advisories.reachability: A malicious/compromised response with excessive content encodings can crash a fetch client. Wrangler/Miniflare performs outbound tooling requests, so conditional tooling exposure is relevant. No Node fetch server runs on the deployed static website.

assessment_scope: npm-locked website dependencies; static production assets; build/CI and developer tooling; host Node bundled Undici assessed separately
